Phase 1 builds a script that turns our Claude Code history into the data for tabs 3 and 4 (Contributions and Token usage). Before writing the plan, I measured how your compact shows up in the history files, so the plan is built on facts rather than guesses.

**What the compact showed (measured, saved in [evidence/phase1-recon/](evidence/phase1-recon/recon-output.txt)):**
- **The compact worked as hoped.** Context went from 305,065 tokens to 14,969 of conversation, in 56 seconds. The app now shows 81,551 tokens in total.
